Tern Queue notification chime options
Record: doc-020
Date: 2025-04-22
Collection: Fictional queue-study archive

The presentation mockup compares a soft click with a short tone for a completed handoff. The samples are prerecorded audio cues; their lengths are not measured queue latency. No completion, retry or persistence logic was changed.

The mockup belongs to the related-record catalog [[doc-016]]. The software queue design remains [[doc-003]].
